name: agent-suggest-card-stack
title: Agent Suggest Card Stack
description: Two overlapping cards summarise an AI agent's suggestions: a header with a count and title, two file rows with a bot badge, and two progress bars. The second bar splits green and red to show passed and failed work.
use: An AI coding agent finishes a task and needs a compact summary of changes with a commit action.
avoid: The text sits inside a fixed-size SVG with fixed coordinates, so long filenames and translation will clip.
a11y: The Apply changes control is SVG text, not a button, and the graphic exposes only an SVG title to assistive tech. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two dark rounded cards offset on top of each other on black. The back card shows a green count pill, "Agent suggestions" and an issue number; the front card has two rows with a sparkle icon, filename, small "bot" pill and two ribbon progress bars.
behaves: The top bar sits full green while the lower mixed bar grows its green passed share against a red remainder across the clip. Nothing else moves, and the Apply changes label is only drawn text.
customise: Width, height, header title and badge, suggestions array, commit label, logo icon and dozens of colour tokens are props.
weight: light: A static SVG with a couple of shadow filters; no script or loop.
demo: 3 Agent suggestions, Update auth config, Fix type errors, Apply changes.
issues: The Apply changes button is drawn as SVG text with no handler, so it looks active but is inert.
polishWhy: Tight, believable agent UI with crisp SVG bars; the commit label is inert.
